en.headline: Hong Kong to send more than 500 athletes to Nagoya Asian Games
en.dek: Culture, Sports and Tourism Secretary Rosanna Law said full funding is being provided for the Games and the final squad will be confirmed at the September flag presentation.
body: Hong Kong will send more than 500 athletes to the Asian Games in Nagoya next month, Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said on Saturday.

Speaking on an RTHK programme, Law said the athletes were preparing well and that the government was providing full funding for participation this year, compared with the usual coverage of about 90 per cent of costs under the sports development fund for major games.
The final number of competing athletes will be announced at the flag presentation ceremony in early September. The Games open on 19 September.
Law also reiterated confidence that Hong Kong would meet its full-year visitor target of 53.8 million, after recording about 31.22 million arrivals in the first seven months.

zh.headline: 港隊亞運派出逾500人 羅淑佩指政府全額資助
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局長表示運動員準備充足，正式名單下月初於授旗儀式公布，賽事9月19日開幕。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩周六在電台節目表示，香港將派出逾500名運動員出戰下月名古屋亞運會。
她指運動員準備充足，今年政府為亞運提供全額資助，而以往大型賽事一般透過體育發展基金資助約九成費用。
正式參賽人數將於9月初授旗儀式公布。亞運會於9月19日開幕。
羅淑佩亦重申有信心全年訪港旅客達5,380萬人次目標，首七個月已錄得約3,122萬人次。
